provenance: Built by static reading of the C# catalog sources with extract.py; nothing was run against a host. Compare with the live tools/list of the pinned build (needs local test).

server.executable: sasaah-revit-mcp (04_Deployments/Sasaah.Mcp.Revit.Server); talks to the Revit add-in bridge over a named pipe (BridgeClient.cs)
server.transport: stdio MCP to the client; named pipe sasaah.revit.bridge.v1 to Revit (ServerConfig.cs:7)
server.tools_source: tools/list is built at request time from the bridge's list_tools reply (Program.cs:71-77): the bridge catalog filtered by its ToolsetFilter (default toolsets read, write, control; destructive and code only when enabled in the Revit user settings, ToolsetFilter.cs) and then by the MCP server's own filters (--toolsets default all, --read-only, --disable-send-code)
server.version_reporting: The bridge list_tools reply carries catalog_version, the first 16 hex characters of SHA-256 over the concatenation of (name, newline, input-schema JSON, newline) for every catalog tool (ListToolsHandler.cs:58-62), surfaced by revit_connection_status (Program.cs:141) and used for notifications/tools/list_changed. It hashes the whole catalog, not the filtered list. ping returns uptime only (ControlHandlers.cs:18-22); no add-in or server build id.

start_options.--disable-send-code: drops compile_and_run and its alias (default: enabled)
start_options.--toolsets: comma list of groups or kinds (default all)
